note: Accepted prepared inputs exported from the pinned Go engine. Capture re-exports into scratch and must match these files exactly.

cases.description: The application's frozen Frost reference request (inventory/first-frost), unchanged.
The Frost reference with Fingers of Frost unlearned. Regression for community fix #622: pinned Go drops the Ice Lance condition and casts Ice Lance on every global cooldown.

reasons: rotation item 4: auraIsActive names spell 400669, which the character lacks; the pinned reference drops the condition and community #622 reads it as inactive

cases.description: Frostbolt only with labeled random streams: the v1 static-frost-60 character through the v2 contract.
Frostbolt only, shared random stream, 120 +/- 15 second fights that run out of mana; keeps the first-fight log golden.
Frostbolt only, shared stream, 300 +/- 30 seconds with Arcane Meditation regeneration while casting.
Frostbolt only, shared stream, spell haste rating and 60 +/- 10 second fights.
Frostbolt only, shared stream, 3 +/- 1 second fights at 30 yards: casts complete without their missiles landing.
The reference character, gear, buffs, consumables and Judgement of Wisdom with only Winter's Chill among proc talents, casting Frostbolt.
As reference-winters-chill with Winter's Chill at rank 3, so each landed Frost spell rolls its proc; keeps the first-fight log golden.
The reference character with Fingers of Frost 2, Shatter 3 and Winter's Chill; Ice Lance while Fingers of Frost is active, then Frostbolt. Keeps the first-fight log golden.
As reference-fingers-of-frost with Fingers of Frost and Shatter at rank 1: one charge per proc and a smaller Shatter bonus.
The reference character with Arcane Concentration and Winter's Chill casting Frostbolt: Clearcasting procs, its internal cooldown and free casts.
The reference character with Missile Barrage and Winter's Chill: Arcane Missiles while Missile Barrage is active, then Frostbolt. Keeps the first-fight log golden.

The reference character and talents with the reference rotation's Ice Lance, Arcane Missiles and Frostbolt rules: every proc talent, without mana recovery or cooldowns. Keeps the first-fight log golden.
The complete reference build in 300 +/- 30 second fights: Evocation, every mana gem, potions, runes and the Robe all fire.
The complete reference build in 600 +/- 60 second fights with seed 7: repeated Evocations and every cooldown cycling.
The Frost reference with Missile Barrage unlearned. The rotation guards the Arcane Missiles rule with auraIsKnown, so pinned Go and community #622 both prune it and the build is supported.
The application's Arcane character as a Gnome without fire talents, casting only Arcane Blast: stacks raise its cost until it runs out of mana.
The same character with the Arcane preset's Missiles, Frostbolt and Arcane Blast rules: Frostbolt spends the stacks after its damage is rolled, and the Missiles channel holds them until it ends.
The application's Arcane character and rotation as a Human without fire talents: Arcane Power and Presence of Mind are cast as major cooldowns.
The same at 400 seconds: Presence of Mind's cooldown restarts when Arcane Blast consumes it, so its second use comes at 181.5 seconds.
The Arcane cooldowns case with the application's fire talents, including Ignite: no reachable spell is fire, so its trigger never acts.

The application's Arcane reference request (ReferenceBuildBySlug arcane-mage with BuildRequest at application revision ad6ea6b8, timeline on), unchanged: Undead with Touch of the Grave, Ignite talented, Arcane Blast, Arcane Power and Presence of Mind.

The application's Arcane reference without Missile Barrage. Regression for community fix #622: the preset's unguarded Arcane Missiles rule makes pinned Go cast Missiles whenever reached (449.7 DPS, no Arcane Blasts) where the fix reads the aura as inactive (396.6 DPS).

reasons: rotation item 3: auraIsActive names spell 44404, which the character lacks; the pinned reference drops the condition and community #622 reads it as inactive

cases.description: The application's Fire character as a Human without Ignite, Heating Up, Master of Elements or Combustion, casting Fire Blast and Scorch: Improved Scorch stacks Fire Vulnerability on the mage.
The fire-scorch character casting Fire Blast and Fireball: the hit lands after travel, then the dot snapshots and ticks on current spell power and multipliers.
The same with Scorch while Fire Vulnerability has fewer than five stacks: the stacks change under running Fireball dots.
The fire-fireball-scorch case with Master of Elements: crits refund part of the base cost, at most once per internal cooldown.
The Master of Elements case with Heating Up and the reference's Pyroblast rule: crits stack a Pyroblast cast time cut, and Pyroblast at three stacks spends them, then its own dot snapshots.
The Heating Up case with Combustion and the reference's Combustion and cooldown rules: each landed Fire hit adds crit until three crits end the buff and start the cooldown.
The Combustion case with Ignite: Fire crits pay a share of their damage over Ignite's ticks, and a crit while the dot runs rolls what it still owes into the new dot.

The application's Fire reference request (ReferenceBuildBySlug fire-mage with BuildRequest at application revision ad6ea6b8, timeline on), unchanged: a Gnome with Eureka!, Scorch, Fireball, Fire Blast, Pyroblast, Heating Up, Combustion, Ignite and Master of Elements.
The Frost reference as a Troll: Berserking, a major cooldown that multiplies cast speed for 10 seconds.
The Frost reference as a Troll in 600-second fights: Berserking expires and is cast again, and every mana cooldown fires.
The Frost reference as an Orc: Blood Fury multiplies spell damage and attack power for 15 seconds; Shatter Curse, a survival cooldown, never fires on its own.
The Frost reference as an Orc in 300-second fights with configured cooldown timings: Shatter Curse is cast at 10 and 200 seconds, Blood Fury at 30 and 160 seconds and then whenever ready.
The Frost reference as a High Order Skyborne: one percent cast speed and Elemental slaying are static; Read Ley Line is cast only by a rotation action, and this rotation has none.
The Fire reference as a High Order Skyborne whose rotation casts Read Ley Line below 60% mana: a two-second cast whose aura Energized doubles mana regeneration for 15 seconds.

The production application's Frostfire hybrid reference request (ReferenceBuildBySlug frostfire-mage with BuildRequest at application revision 18bbcd47, timeline on), unchanged: a Gnome casting every Frostfire Bolt rank's hit and snapshot dot, with Fire and Frost talents.
The production application's Fire Missile Barrage 16/31/4 reference request (ReferenceBuildBySlug fire-mage with BuildRequest at application revision 18bbcd47, timeline on), unchanged.
production-frostfire against a target with 120 Fire and 60 Frost resistance at 1000 iterations: Frostfire Bolt checks the lower of the two.

frost-reference with prepull Frostbolts at -6 and -2.5 seconds and a hidden Evocation: prepull casts run in Go's time order, the first sets the starting time, and mana ticks start two seconds after it.

The production application's Balance Druid reference request (ReferenceBuildBySlug balance-druid with BuildRequest at application revision 18bbcd47, timeline on), unchanged: a Night Elf Moonkin with Elune's Light, prepull Moonkin Form and Wrath, every Starfire and Wrath rank, Moonfire and Insect Swarm dots, Innervate, Omen of Clarity, Nature's Grace and Eclipse.

The production application's Elemental Shaman request at application revision 18bbcd47: Tauren, Lightning Bolt with a prepull cast and a downranked filler, Chain Lightning, Flame Shock, Lava Burst, Fire Nova and Searing Totem, Lightning Overload, Elemental Focus and the math rotation operator.

The production Elemental Shaman request as a Dwarf in 300-second fights with Stoneform timings at 10 and 200 seconds: the survival cooldown is cast at its timings, and its physical damage taken change has no effect.

The production Retribution Paladin request with no talents, rotation, consumables, enchants or party and raid buffs at 1000 iterations: main hand auto attacks on the white hit table, the randomized first swing, the raid's Sunder Armor ramp and Judgement of Wisdom from melee hits.
paladin-auto-attacks from in front of the target, where swings can be parried and blocked.

The production application's Destruction Warlock request at application revision 18bbcd47: Undead, Imp sacrificed before the pull, Shadow Bolt with Improved Shadow Bolt, Immolate, Corruption, Bane of Agony, Curse of the Elements, Conflagrate and Shadowburn with Shadow and Flame, Searing Pain, Life Tap and the raid's ramped Sunder Armor; supported and matches Go
paladin-auto-attacks with Expose Armor as well as Sunder Armor: Expose Armor holds the exclusive armor slot, so every Sunder tick is refused.

The production application's Shadow Priest reference build at application revision 18bbcd47: Undead, Shadowform, Mind Blast, Shadow Word: Pain, Devouring Plague, Shadow Word: Death, Mind Flay channels the rotation interrupts, a strict Inner Focus and Mind Blast sequence, Shadow Weaving, Dark Sacrifice, Touch of the Grave and the inert Shadowfiend pet
The production Shadow Priest request with allowRecast off on the Mind Flay channel, so an interrupt that would recast Mind Flay keeps channeling
The production Shadow Priest request with no interrupt condition on the Mind Flay channel, which Go then treats as a plain cast

The production Shadow Priest request whose strict sequence follows Inner Focus with Devouring Plague, which is on cooldown, so the sequence gives up control and the rotation continues; a 300 second fight

paladin-auto-attacks with the production weapon and armor enchants, Crusader among them, and Dragonbreath Chili: per-hand proc chances, Holy Strength through the stat-aura combinations, the heal and the delayed chili hit.

paladin-crusader-chili with the party Windfury Totem: the trigger's chance and cooldown, charges of attack power through the stat-aura combinations, one fewer when an auto grants them, the extra main hand attack and the totem refreshed every five seconds.

The production application's Smite Priest hybrid at application revision 18bbcd47: Undead, a prepull Holy Fire, a strict Inner Focus and Holy Fire sequence on Holy Fire's remaining time, Penance channels, Shadow Word: Pain, Devouring Plague, Smite on a mana and remaining time math condition, Power in Light, Searing Light, Dark Sacrifice and the inert Shadowfiend

The production Fury Warrior request queueing Cleave at 40 rage, with Raging Blows' cheaper cost and no refund
